arStrings.szText: {c_important}Fire Bolt{/c} launches an additional parallel bolt, dealing {c_number}{payload:DAMAGE}{/c} Fire damage.

{c_important}Fire Bolt{/c} shoots out a firefly that attaches itself to an enemy and explodes {c_number}{SF_39}{/c} times after a delay, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_FIREFLY_AOE_DAMAGE}{/c} damage with each explosion.

{c_important}Fire Bolt{/c} becomes a {c_important}Frost{/c} Skill, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_DAMAGE}{/c} Cold damage and {c_number}{dot:UPGRADEC_FROSTBITE}{/c} Frostbite damage over {c_number}[SF_0]{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Fire Bolt{/c} pierces {c_number}[SF_27]{/c} time and makes enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/c}{/u} for {c_number}{SF_24}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Fire Bolt{/c} heals you for {c_number}[SF_28 * 100]%{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_28]){/c} when it hits the first enemy.
{c_important}Fire Bolt{/c} generates {c_number}[SF_29]{/c} Mana when it hits the first enemy, or {c_number}[SF_30]{/c} Mana if the enemy is already {if:Mod.UpgradeC}Frostbitten{else}Burning{/if}.
